desc: Verify the correction term T formula for i=j edge cases and ensure no overcounting.
Write a function to compute C^p mod p for N×N matrix using binary exponentiation.
Implement the T matrix construction: iterate over all (i,j) with A_{i,j}=0, apply rules for i≠j and i=j.
Handle p=2 case separately: compute row/col sums and M^2 (where M_{i,j}=1 if A_{i,j}=0 else 0) and combine.
Combine results and output S mod p for each element.
Test with sample inputs and edge cases (e.g., all zeros, p=2).
